reviewBoundary: Newly authored provisional primary-school text practices. Exact answer evidence and every distractor were checked by the author only; this is not independent teacher review, learner calibration, an official examination or publication approval.

materials.title: Cafe Order Correction 018
materials.text: A child is at a café with Dad. Read each need and choose what the child should say.

questions.prompt: You asked for water, but the helper brings milk. What do you say?
options: Thank you, but I asked for water.
Give my cup to the floor.
questions.explanation: A礼貌指出误给并说所点水；B牛奶非颜色；C把杯给地面不能纠正点单。

questions.prompt: Your soup is too hot to eat. You want to wait. What do you say?
options: I will eat it very fast now.
I will let it cool first.
questions.explanation: B先冷却符合太热需等；A快吃、C更热均不满足当前需要。

questions.prompt: You want bread without butter. What do you say?
options: Please put butter on every piece.
Please take all the bread away.
May I have bread without butter?
questions.explanation: C明确要无黄油面包；A反向加黄油；B不要全部面包不等于想吃无黄油。

questions.prompt: You have dropped your spoon and need a clean one. What do you say?
options: May I have a clean spoon, please?
questions.explanation: A索取净勺解决落地；B窗、C云数无关。

questions.prompt: The helper asks if you want more food. You have had enough. What do you say?
options: No, thank you. I am full.
My shoe is under the chair.
questions.explanation: B礼貌谢绝并说明吃饱；A全要与足量相反；C鞋位不回答加餐。

materials.title: Basketball Turn Cards 018
materials.text: At the basketball game, each child gets three throws. Wait behind the cone until your name is called. Give the ball back to the helper after your turn. A child may use the lower basket if the high one is too hard. Put your turn card in the box when you finish.

questions.prompt: A friend has used three throws and wants a fourth. You say, "____"
questions.explanation: B每人三投已完成；A加十、C占球均违轮次。

questions.prompt: A friend runs past the cone before being called. You say, "____"
options: Wait behind the cone for your name.
questions.explanation: C叫名前锥后等；A继续前跑、B乱叫均不合等待。

questions.prompt: A small child cannot reach the high basket. You say, "____"
options: You may use the lower basket.
You must throw with no ball.
questions.explanation: A允许较低篮；B回家、C无球投非适应办法。

questions.prompt: A friend finishes and holds the ball away from the helper. You say, "____"
options: Hide the ball in a bag.
Give the ball back to the helper.
Take it to the next classroom.
questions.explanation: B轮后归帮手；A藏、C送别班非回收。

questions.prompt: A friend finishes but keeps the turn card. You say, "____"
options: Use it for another full turn now.
Put your card in the box.
questions.explanation: C完成卡入盒；A重复轮次无许可；B球内非卡存处。

materials.title: Dripping Tap Cup 018
materials.text: At night, I hear drops in the bathroom. Dad checks the tap. It is closed, but water still drips. He puts a cup below it so we can see how much water is lost. In the morning, the cup is half full. Mum calls a repair worker. I use the collected clean water on our flowerpot. The worker fixes the tap that afternoon. The next night is quiet.

questions.prompt: The tap is open when Dad first checks it.
questions.explanation: B正确：closed but still drips；A把故障滴水当开着。

questions.prompt: Dad puts a cup below the tap.
questions.explanation: A正确：cup below it；B否认检查记录方法。

questions.prompt: The cup is half full the next morning.
questions.explanation: A正确：morning half full；B否认观察量。

questions.prompt: The writer pours the collected water into a flowerpot.
questions.explanation: A正确：use collected clean water on flowerpot；B否认再利用动作。

questions.prompt: The tap is still dripping the next night.
questions.explanation: B正确：afternoon修好，next night quiet；A忽略修复结果。

materials.title: Hidden Garden Seat 018
materials.text: My aunt has a small seat behind her tall flowers. From the path, it is hard to see. I think she has lost her chair. She takes my hand and leads me around the flowers. There it is, beside a little table. On the table is my favourite book. Aunt says it is our quiet reading place. We sit there until it starts to rain, then take the book inside.

questions.prompt: The seat is behind tall flowers.
questions.explanation: A正确：seat behind tall flowers；B否认藏处。

questions.prompt: The writer can see the seat easily from the path.
questions.explanation: B正确：hard to see；A易见与难见相反。

questions.prompt: Aunt shows the writer where the seat is.
questions.explanation: A正确：牵手领绕花丛到座；B否认引导。

questions.prompt: A favourite book is on the little table.
questions.explanation: A正确：table favourite book；B否认准备物。

questions.prompt: They leave the book outside in the rain.
questions.explanation: B正确：雨起take book inside；A与保护书动作相反。

materials.title: Bookmark Little Lighthouse 018
materials.text: Nina makes a bookmark shaped like a lighthouse. She gives it to her grandpa, who reads every evening. A week later, she visits and sees the bookmark on a shelf, not in his book. She feels sad and thinks he does not like it. Grandpa opens a small box. Inside are other paper gifts from Nina. "I keep your things here when I am not reading," he says. Then he puts the lighthouse in the chapter he has just finished. Nina realises that a gift can be out of sight and still be cared for.

questions.prompt: What shape is Nina’s bookmark?
questions.explanation: A灯塔形书签；B鞋、C公交均非形状。

questions.prompt: Why does Nina feel sad at first?
options: She thinks Grandpa does not like her gift.
questions.explanation: B未在书中而误以为不喜欢；A书有章节；C未要求离开。

questions.prompt: What is in Grandpa’s small box?
questions.explanation: C她以前纸礼物；A钱、B破眼镜均未提。

questions.prompt: What does Grandpa do with the bookmark?
options: Put it in his current book.
Give it to an unknown visitor.
questions.explanation: A放刚读完章节处；B丢弃、C转陌客均非动作。

questions.prompt: What does Nina learn?
options: Every gift must stay visible all day.
Something out of sight may still be valued.
questions.explanation: B结尾明示不显眼仍珍惜；A全天展示要求与理解相反；C书签已作礼物。

materials.title: Shy Stage Helper 018
materials.text: Our class prepares a puppet show. Robin does not want to speak on stage. At first, he thinks there is no job for him. The teacher asks him to manage the curtain and hand props to the speakers. He practises when to open the curtain after the music starts. On show day, one puppet loses its paper hat. Robin finds the spare hat and passes it over quietly. The audience does not see him, but the class thanks him after the show.

questions.prompt: Robin wants to give a long speech on stage.
questions.explanation: B正确：does not want speak stage；A意愿反向。

questions.prompt: The teacher finds backstage jobs for Robin.
questions.explanation: A正确：管幕递道具；B否认安排。

questions.prompt: Robin opens the curtain before the music starts.
questions.explanation: B正确：after music starts；A先后颠倒。

questions.prompt: Robin helps when a puppet loses its hat.
questions.explanation: A正确：找备用帽悄递；B否认临场帮助。

questions.prompt: The class thanks Robin even though the audience does not see him.
questions.explanation: A正确：观众未见但班级谢；B否认幕后贡献被认可。

units.title: 小提琴声从另一扇门传来

materials.title: Wrong Garden Gate Story 018
materials.text:
On her first day at the music club, Esme followed a violin sound down a narrow lane. She found a green gate and waited. No one opened it. She was about to go home when an old man came out carrying gardening gloves. He had been listening to a radio. The violin she had followed was not a lesson.
Esme showed him the club message on paper. It said "Garden Hall, east gate." She had remembered only the word "garden." The man pointed to a building beyond the lane. Its east gate faced the next street. Esme thanked him and arrived ten minutes late. The teacher welcomed her and asked her to read the whole direction next time. At the end of the lesson, she wrote a small arrow on her copy of the message. She kept the friendly mistake as a reminder that a familiar word was not the whole instruction.

questions.prompt: Why does Esme first wait at the green gate?
options: She has arranged to meet the gardener.
She follows a violin sound and assumes it is the club.
Her teacher tells her to use that gate.
questions.explanation: B跟琴声误认音乐社；A园丁无约；C教师未指定绿门；D手套非目的。

questions.prompt: Where does the violin sound actually come from?
options: A lesson behind the green gate.
questions.explanation: C老人听广播；A正被否定；B车、D本人琴无据。

questions.prompt: What detail in the message did Esme miss?
options: The east gate of Garden Hall.
questions.explanation: A只记garden遗漏Hall和east gate；B/C/D不在路线指令。

questions.prompt: How does the teacher respond to Esme’s late arrival?
options: She tells her never to return.
She sends her to the gardener.
She welcomes her and asks her to read directions fully.
questions.explanation: D欢迎并提醒读全；A/B/C均不合原文。

questions.prompt: What does Esme’s added arrow represent?
options: A plan to find a different club.
A reminder of the correct approach.
A request to buy the green gate.
A claim that sound always gives exact directions.
questions.explanation: B她在路线纸上添箭头帮助记正确入口；A没换社；C没买门；D故事说明声和熟词不足定位。

units.title: 社团整理时怎样把话说清楚

materials.title: Club Room Helpful Lines 018
materials.text:
Match each situation with the sentence that fits it best. Use each sentence once.
A. I can carry the lighter box while you take the heavy one.
B. Could we move it away from the doorway?
C. Please put my name on the waiting list.
D. I will return it before the club closes.
E. Could you show me the safe way to fold it?

questions.prompt: A friend cannot carry both boxes, and you want to share the work.
options: I can carry the lighter box while you take the heavy one.
Could we move it away from the doorway?
Please put my name on the waiting list.
I will return it before the club closes.
Could you show me the safe way to fold it?
questions.explanation: A分担轻箱，另一人重箱，回应负担；B门口、C候补、D归还、E折叠求教不直接分箱搬。

questions.prompt: A table blocks the entrance, and you suggest a better position.
options: I can carry the lighter box while you take the heavy one.
Could we move it away from the doorway?
Please put my name on the waiting list.
I will return it before the club closes.
Could you show me the safe way to fold it?
questions.explanation: B移开门口直接解决阻道；A搬箱分工、C候补、D归还时间、E折叠方法均不问桌位。

questions.prompt: A workshop is full, but you would like a place if someone cancels.
options: I can carry the lighter box while you take the heavy one.
Could we move it away from the doorway?
Please put my name on the waiting list.
I will return it before the club closes.
Could you show me the safe way to fold it?
questions.explanation: C请求候补名单；A搬箱、B移桌、D归还、E折叠均不表达补位意愿。

questions.prompt: You borrow the club’s ruler and promise when it will come back.
options: I can carry the lighter box while you take the heavy one.
Could we move it away from the doorway?
Please put my name on the waiting list.
I will return it before the club closes.
Could you show me the safe way to fold it?
questions.explanation: D承诺关社前归还；A分工、B位置、C候补、E方法均未承诺时间。

questions.prompt: You have a folding stool but do not know how to close it safely.
options: I can carry the lighter box while you take the heavy one.
Could we move it away from the doorway?
Please put my name on the waiting list.
I will return it before the club closes.
Could you show me the safe way to fold it?
questions.explanation: E请求演示安全折叠；A箱分工、B桌位置、C候补、D归还时间不能回答操作困难。

units.title: 雨中自行车座上的旧外套

materials.title: Bicycle Coat Rain Story 018
materials.text:
Noah left his bicycle outside the evening class. When the lesson ended, rain was falling hard. Someone had wrapped an old coat around his seat. He felt grateful and searched for the owner, but the street was nearly empty. A woman at the next doorway said that an elderly man had passed by with a cart.
Noah cycled after the man and offered the coat back. The man looked surprised. He had covered the seat because a small cloth bag was hanging below it, open to the rain. Noah had not noticed that his bag zip was undone. The coat had protected his sketchbook as well as the seat.
Noah asked how to repay him. The man said the coat had been in his cart on its way to a repair shop; it was not rubbish. He gladly took it back and accepted Noah’s help pushing the cart over a rough patch. Noah rode home with dry drawings and a changed idea of the small favour he had received.

questions.prompt: What does Noah first notice after class?
options: An old coat covers his wet-weather bicycle seat.
His teacher is wearing his coat.
questions.explanation: B看到旧外套裹车座；A车仍在；C画受保护；D教师未穿。

questions.prompt: Why had the man covered that part of the bicycle?
options: To claim the bicycle as his own.
To protect an open bag from the rain.
To throw away the coat without being seen.
questions.explanation: C注意挂袋开着，保护袋；A占车、B告示、D丢弃均非目的。

questions.prompt: What had Noah failed to notice?
options: The coat was new and expensive.
questions.explanation: A没留意袋拉链未合；B/C不符叙事；D只旧 coat不知昂贵。

questions.prompt: What does the man say about the coat?
options: It is rubbish for anyone to take.
It must remain on the bicycle forever.
He is taking it to be repaired.
questions.explanation: D要送修，不是废物；A与not rubbish矛盾；B无教师归属；C愿收回。

questions.prompt: How does Noah help in return?
options: He helps push the cart over rough ground.
He leaves the coat in the rain.
questions.explanation: B推车过崎岖处；A买车、C弃衣、D送全画均非行动。

materials.title: Missing Comic Page Letter 018
materials.text:
Dear Hana,
I thought I had damaged your comic when I found a missing page. I was ready to buy a new copy before telling you. Then I checked the photo you had sent when you lent it to me. The page edge in that photo already looked torn. I still could not be certain from the small picture, so I wrote to ask rather than deciding for myself. You explained that the page had fallen out last year and was kept safely in a folder. I was relieved. We agreed to store the loose page with the book before lending it again. Next time, I will check a borrowed item’s condition at the start and tell its owner promptly about a concern, instead of quietly assuming either blame or innocence.
Best,
Ari

questions.prompt: Ari first considers buying a replacement before explaining the concern.
questions.explanation: A正确：ready buy new before telling；B否认初始想法。

questions.prompt: The small photo proves every detail with complete certainty.
questions.explanation: B正确：still could not be certain；A把线索夸为完全证据。

questions.prompt: Hana says the page fell out last year.
questions.explanation: A正确：page fallen out last year；B否认已知历史。

questions.prompt: The missing page has been destroyed and cannot be found.
questions.explanation: B正确：safe in folder；A捏造销毁遗失。

questions.prompt: They agree to keep the loose page with the book before lending again.
questions.explanation: A正确：agreed store loose page with book；B否认改进安排。
